description: The input parameters for an interactive session task. Running the task starts a JupyterLab session with no network access, over read-only copies of input files that the person starting it can download. Results leave the session only through review: when the session ends, the files it wrote to /outputs wait in IN_REVIEW until someone other than the person who ran it approves them.

inputFolderId.description: Optional. The Synapse ID of the Folder whose direct-child FileEntities are copied, read-only, into the session's /inputs. The person starting the session must be able to download every one of them.

inputTaskIds.description: Optional. The IDs of interactive session tasks in the same project whose approved outputs are also inputs of this session. Each must be COMPLETED. This chains sessions: one session's reviewed results become the next one's read-only inputs.

workspaceTaskId.description: Optional. The ID of an interactive session task in the same project whose /workspace this session shares, so that collaborators work on the same files. The referenced task must not itself share another task's workspace. A session in a shared workspace only starts if everyone who has run a session in it can download every input of every task in it.

environmentId.description: The ID of the approved environment the session runs in. An environment is an image with a reviewed list of packages; nothing else can be installed, since the session has no network.

maxDurationMinutes.description: How long the session may run before it is ended automatically, in minutes. At most 720.
